scenes.say: The menu is on the left and across the top, with the same pages in both.
Home is where you land, and the logo always brings you back.
Settings has four tabs: Profile, Social Accounts, CRM and Billing.
At the top of Profile, Your studio shows what's still to set up, with a button for each.
Your initial, top right, has your plan and Sign Out.
And the gold star is Sparklee, who answers out loud when you ask how to do something.

title: Home — Tell Sparklee What You Want

scenes.say: On Home, tell Sparklee what you want.

do.hover: h~:^What do you want to accomplish

scenes.say: Tap the mic and say it, or type it, then press Send.
For example: keep me visible to sellers in my town this week.

do.type: Keep me visible to sellers in my town this week

scenes.say: Sparklee checks your plan, your videos left and your accounts, then shows her plan: each video, the day it posts, and where.
Edit plan changes a day or removes a step.
Approve plan writes the drafts.
No video is made yet, and nothing posts without your approval.
Below Ask Sparklee, Needs Your Approval holds your drafts.
Watch a finished one and press Approve, or press Make video on one that isn't made yet.
Opportunities Sparklee Found are ideas from real signs, like a quiet week or a post that did well.
Make draft hands one to Sparklee.
Working For You shows what's being made and what's booked.
And This Week shows each day: green is posted, blue is booked, gold is waiting on you.
On paid plans you can have two twins: a vertical one, filmed with your phone upright, for Reels and Shorts, and a horizontal one for YouTube.
Each video uses the one that fits, so you're full screen in both.

do.hover: text:One of each, and we use the one that fits the video.

scenes.say: Each twin is trained and approved on its own.
When Settings shows Approval Required, press Approve My Digital Twin and follow the short approval on camera.
Until then, it can't be used in a video.
Your twin is filmed upright, so in a horizontal video your background can be taken away.
In video setup, under Background, press On my background.
Choose Photos and footage to stand in front of the video's own clips, at the side or in a corner.
Or pick a saved background or a color.
In Settings, Wide videos sets what new videos start on, and Your backgrounds keeps your pictures.
Press Describe, say a place, and press Make it.
Want your twin in something else?

do.hover: text~:Your twin in a different outfit

scenes.say: In Settings, under Digital Twin, find Outfits.
Describe it, like a navy blazer over a white shirt, and press New outfit.

do.type: Navy blazer over a white shirt
do.into: ph:Describe the outfit, e.g. navy blazer over a white shirt

scenes.say: In a minute or two it's ready, and it moves just like your twin.

do.hover: text~:Your twin in a different outfit

scenes.say: Each outfit shows up as a look in video setup.

do.hover: text~:Your twin in a different outfit

scenes.say: Your first new look each month is free.

do.hover: text~:Your first new look each month is free

scenes.say: Tap the bin to remove one.
Your Google review link lives at the bottom of Social Accounts in Settings.
In your Google Business Profile, press Ask for reviews, then Copy link.
Paste it here and press Save.
It becomes the gold button in your review request emails.
Under it, save your default review words and subject, and they fill in every time you ask for a review.

title: When YouTube Won't Take Your Thumbnail

scenes.say: YouTube only takes your custom thumbnails from a phone-verified channel.
Verify at youtube dot com slash verify, and check the picture at the top right is this channel.
If it isn't, use a private window.
One phone number verifies two channels a year.
If a thumbnail didn't go up, open the video's Publish window in My Sparks, and press Update it on YouTube under the thumbnail.
Already written it?
In Spark Studio, open More options, and under Script source choose My Content, Forwarded in.
Paste your words, or attach a PDF, a link, or an email you forwarded in.
Emails you forward show up here with a new badge.
On a video, choose Speak it word for word for a finished script, or Have AI write from it.
Then press Write my script, and read it before anything is made.
To write a blog with no video, press the Blog card in Spark Studio, or start your sentence with create a blog.
Say or type the topic, and check your town under Details.
Bringing your own words?
Choose Use it as it is to publish your writing unchanged, or Write a new article from it for someone else's newsletter or a market report.
Blog posts never use a video from your plan.
Under Details, three optional pickers shape everything that's written: Audience, Tone, and Why.
You can also just say them, like for first-time buyers.
Is your audience not on the list?
Choose Add your own at the bottom of Audience and type it, like nurses relocating.
It's saved to your account, on your phone and your computer.
Choose it again to remove it.
Stuck on a page?

do.hover: h~:^What do you want to accomplish

scenes.say: Tap Ask Sparklee, the gold star at the top right, and ask out loud how to do something.
She answers in a few seconds, out loud and on screen, from this guide.
Each conversation runs up to five minutes.
Tap Stop when you're done.
On paid plans, Sparklee can make the whole video herself.
Press Sparklee, make it under the box, and say it all at once: a market update for Springfield this week, horizontal, my twin, post it Friday.

do.type: A market update for Springfield this week, horizontal, my twin, post it Friday

scenes.say: She asks only for what's missing, then shows what she'll create and waits.
Press Create it, and in about ten minutes your video comes back as a card.
Watch it, edit the thumbnail or title, then Approve to post.
No idea where to start?
The box shows a Try example that changes every few seconds.
Press the empty box to use it.
Under it, Quick win is a ready topic for your town in one press.
What buyers ask AI shows real questions buyers ask.
And Or try has ideas with your city filled in.
More ideas opens the whole list, with a search box.
Tap one and it lands in the box, ready to add to.
Agent Intro is a thirty-second video introducing you.
Tap the Agent Intro chip in Spark Studio.
Your name, brokerage, area and years fill in from Settings.
Pick who you help most, and add something personal.
You get the intro script, plus a short and a long bio in your Share Kit.
With your Digital Twin it's made on our most lifelike avatar.
Producer and Influencer get one free every month.
Above the Spark Video button, Ready to make checks your voice, your look, your twin approval and your videos left.
Anything not ready has a button that fixes it, like Approve now or Get more, and Spark Video stays off until it's all green.

do.hover: text~:One thing left before Spark Video

scenes.say: Avatar video takes up to two hundred ninety words.
If your script is longer, press Shorten to fit.
You can close the page while it's made; Sparklee tells you when it's ready.
Have a Halo website?
In Settings, under CRM, press Add your Halo site, type the address, and press Add.
Every morning SparkReels looks for what's new on it, like blog posts, guides and your market report, and turns them into video drafts on AutoSparks.
Choose which pages under Videos from, how many a month, and the day and time.
Then set the look, avatar, size, accounts, captions and music every Halo video starts with.
Each Halo draft shows its thumbnail, setup, and the post it came from.
Press Setup to change the look, size, picture or day.
Press Edit script to change the words, then Save Draft.
Nothing is made until you press Make video on the card, and a draft never makes a second video.
When it's done, press Watch, edit the thumbnail, title and caption, then Approve to post.
Don't post it yourself too.

title: Put It On Your Halo Post

scenes.say: Once your video is live on YouTube, put it on the Halo post it came from.
The card shows Put on my Halo post.
It writes the message for you, and on your phone Text Halo opens your messages with it filled in.
Once Halo adds it, the card says On your Halo post.
If it hasn't noticed yet, press It's on my post.

title: Promo Video For Your Halo Page

scenes.say: Are you a Halo affiliate?
Add your Halo referral page as a site, and it's marked Affiliate, with a Make promo video button.
Pick an angle, like Why I use Halo, and press Write it.
The script uses your referral code, and says out loud that you earn a referral fee.
It's set to post to Facebook, LinkedIn and Instagram, where other agents will see it.
Every email you forward to your import address also becomes a video draft on AutoSparks, marked Email, about a minute after it arrives.
The script is written fresh from the email, so a market report is never posted word for word.
Setup, Make video and Approve to post work just like a Halo draft.
To turn it off, use the Forwarded emails switch.
Seller updates on AutoSparks send your weekly seller update by itself.
Turn it on, and pick the day, the time, and Avatar in circle or Email only.
Each listing with sellers from BoldTrail gets a card.
Type the week's numbers and what buyers said, then press Write it and make video.
Watch it, preview the email, and press Approve to send.
It goes to each seller through BoldTrail on its day.
Before you record, read your script in the box, or press Read it full screen to see it large and edit it there.

do.type: Thinking about selling this winter? Here are three things buyers care about right now. First, price it right. Second, make it bright. Third, be flexible on showings.
do.into: ph:Type your script, or tap the mic to speak it…

do.hover: ph:Type your script, or tap the mic to speak it…

scenes.say: Then pick how it scrolls.
Flow follows your voice and keeps your line near the top.
Auto scrolls at a steady speed: slow, medium, or fast.
While you record in Auto, tap minus or plus to slow it down or speed it up.
If Flow feels behind you, switch to Auto.
In Set up your take, Behind you is what fills the screen while you talk in the corner.
Just me is you, full screen.
Or choose your photos, your own footage, or AI scenes made from your script.
Photos and footage are free; AI scenes use one short video.
Smooth skin softens fine lines while you record.
And with a clip or scenes, tick Open on it to start on five seconds of it with a title.

title: Post A Video You Already Shot

scenes.say: Have a video you already shot?
On a computer, open Camera and Teleprompter and press Post a video as is.
Choose a clip from your computer, up to two minutes.

do.hover: text~:Choose a clip you already shot

scenes.say: Keep its own sound, or record a new voiceover.

do.hover: text~:Choose a clip you already shot

scenes.say: Add a title, a hook and the city, then press Brand this clip.

do.hover: text~:Choose a clip you already shot

scenes.say: Your logo and captions are added, and it's saved to My Sparks, ready to publish.
It counts as a camera recording.

title: Photos Only Reel: Classic Or Cinematic

scenes.say: Photos only reel needs no script.
Add up to twelve photos, or paste a Zillow or Redfin link and they're brought in for you.

do.hover: ph:Paste a listing link to bring in its photos

scenes.say: Pick vertical or horizontal, a length, music, and a voiceover in your own voice if you like.
Then choose the Motion.
Classic is a slow pan across each photo, and it's free.
Cinematic turns each photo into real camera movement, and uses one short video.
Press Build the reel.

title: Open With Me In Front Of The Home

scenes.say: Open with me in front of the home starts a listing video or a photo reel with a six-second shot of you at the front of the home, made with AI from your look and its front photo.
Choose Full body, Chest up, or Off.
It uses your Digital Twin once it's approved, otherwise your headshot.
It works on vertical and horizontal videos.
Want to post the photos themselves?
Post these photos, at the foot of the form, sends them as one post to swipe through on Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, X or TikTok.
No video is made, and nothing comes out of your plan.
Pick the accounts, write one caption, and send.
The order you arranged them in is the swipe order.
Quick Reels Templates, on Spark Studio's first screen, makes a short designed reel.
Pick Just Listed, Luxury Listing, Market Update, Neighborhood Spotlight, or Agent Introduction.
Your name, brokerage and a saved listing fill in the words, and you can change any of them.
Add up to twelve photos, choose the shape, a background color and music, and watch the preview change as you go.
Then Next, script, and Make video.

title: Edit Your Article And Its Pictures

scenes.say: To change your blog article, press Edit in the Share Kit.
The introduction, body and conclusion become boxes you can type in, and Save keeps your changes.
Header image makes a real photo for the top of the article.
Then Moving header turns it into a short loop of slow camera movement, and Social teaser makes a vertical clip to post with your link.
None of them use a video from your plan.
Send to Website gets your article, your video, or both onto your site.
Find it at the top of your Share Kit, or on any video in My Sparks.
With a Halo website, choose Update a post or New post, and Text Halo fills in the request for you.
For any other website, press Copy as HTML, paste it into a new post, and publish it there.
Then paste the post's address into Posted it.

title: Turn Your Article Into An Email

scenes.say: Email, in the article's buttons, turns your blog into a short email for your list, with a button to the full post.
Paste in the post's address on your site.
Send me a test to see it in a real inbox.
Copy as HTML drops it into the email tool you already use.
And with BoldTrail connected, you can send it to up to ten people from your BoldTrail address.
To make a newsletter, open My Sparks and press Make a newsletter above your blog posts.
Tick two to five posts, and press Make the newsletter.
You get three subject lines, a short note from you, a few lines on each post with its own Read more button, and your sign-off.
Paste each post's web address once.
Then Copy as HTML, or Send me a test first.
At the top of the Publish window, Where it's posted is the record for that video: one line for each platform, posted, on its way, scheduled, or failed and why.
A failed line has Retry.
If a post fails after you leave, a red note appears at the top of My Sparks, and you get an email.
Sparklee leaves notes there too: Fixed for you, or Needs you, with the button to fix it.
Google Business takes up to thirty seconds of video and no phone numbers.
So a longer video goes up as a photo post with your caption and a Learn more button.
For an open house, tick Post to Google as an event, and add a name, the date, and the start and end times.
Google shows the date, and takes the post down by itself afterwards.
Any finished video in My Sparks can be emailed.
Press Email it and add up to ten people: search BoldTrail by name, or add someone new.
SparkReels writes a short subject and note you can change or say out loud.
Put first name in curly brackets, and each person sees their own name.
The email shows your thumbnail with a Watch the video button.
Press Send email and confirm.
Record My Screen shows a listing, a market report, or anything else on your screen while you talk.
Open it in Spark Tools, or under the script choices on the camera page.
Tick Show me in a corner circle if you want to be in it.

do.hover: text:Show me in a corner circle

scenes.say: Press Start recording, pick the tab or window, talk as you go, and press Stop.
Up to ten minutes, free, and saved to My Sparks.
Google Reviews, in Spark Tools under Reviews, shows the reviews on your Google Business profile, with your average.
Needs a reply is ticked, so you see only the ones you haven't answered.
On any review, Draft a reply writes one in your voice to edit, or Write my own gives you an empty box.
Nothing goes to Google until you press Post reply.
Read replies to low ratings with extra care.

title: Ask For A Google Review With A Video

scenes.say: Ask for Google Review Video Email sends past clients a short video asking for a review, with a big gold button under it.

do.click: btn:Ask for Google Review Video Email

do.hover: h:Ask for Google Review Video Email

scenes.say: Step one: pick up to ten people.
Step two: your video.
Record it yourself for free, use Avatar in circle, a photo reel, or a video you made.
Make one general video and press Save as my review video, so it's ready every time.
Then check the email, and send.
Seller Update writes an update email for the people selling one of your listings.
Add the listing once.
For each update, fill in views, saves, showings and offers, and type or say what buyers said.
Last week's numbers show beside each box.
Record a video update opens the camera with a short script.
To send through BoldTrail, add the sellers in the orange box, then press Send to sellers through BoldTrail.
Meet, in the top bar, starts a video call with a client.
Start now opens a new Google Meet in a new tab; copy the link and send it.
Schedule for later asks for your client's name and email, the date and time, and opens Google Calendar with it filled in.
Press Save, then Send.
The meeting shows on Spark Calendar as a gold camera on its day.
The Thumbnail Generator makes the cover picture for a video.
Pick the video, type a few words or let AI write them, and choose the photo.

do.hover: ph:3–4 words, or pick a project and AI writes them

scenes.say: Change the words or the photo any time, and press Update Thumbnail to redraw it in seconds.
The Market Badge is the city and state on it.

do.hover: ph:3–4 words, or pick a project and AI writes them

scenes.say: Type a new one to change it, or clear both boxes to leave it off.
Banners makes the wide picture across the top of your YouTube channel, your LinkedIn profile, or your Facebook page, each at the right size.
For YouTube, press Use this template, and your photo, logo, name and contact details fill in from Settings.
Pick a color palette, or Custom for your own colors.
Then download it, or Download for Canva to change the text there.
Video Business Card is two things.
Your card page shows your Agent Intro, your name and logo, and buttons to call, text, email, book a call, or save your contact.
Add a title and booking link, pick a color, and press Save card.
Your video card is your video with your name strip and an end card with a QR code to your page.
Share it with Copy, Text it, a QR code for print, or your email signature.
Also a Halo affiliate?
On the Affiliate page, put your Halo page or code in Your Halo affiliate link, and press Save.
Agents you refer to SparkReels then get your link on their Get Halo button.
Under it, Pressed Get Halo lists each agent who pressed it, so you can see who signed up.
